subject: feat(xxhash3): Support LASX instruction set and refactor LSX implement
perf_evidence: Message: '1. Use __lsx_vmul_d directly instead of using 2 32-bit multiply to emulate a 64-bit multiply. 2. Add LASX support.' (fewer instructions; 256-bit SIMD path).
change_summary: XXH3_scrambleAcc_lsx: acc*=PRIME32_1 via one __lsx_vmul_d with a 64-bit splat instead of two vmulwev.d.wu + shift + add. New XXH_VECTOR=XXH_LASX (accumulate_512_lasx / scrambleAcc_lasx on 256-bit vectors), preferred over LSX when __loongarch_asx.

notes: x86-64 IR unchanged under clang: all one-shot APIs (symbolic len) with -march=x86-64-v3 and default SSE2 give identical modules except !srcloc line metadata (x86_ident_v3/, x86_ident_sse2/). Default loongarch64 (LSX) target IR identical for the APIs (ident_la64_default/) - the LSX accumulate is unchanged; only scrambleAcc_lsx changed. Flags: --target loongarch64-linux-gnu, cflags '-O3 -fno-strict-aliasing -fno-vectorize -fno-slp-vectorize -w -nostdlibinc -isystem _work2020/cross_sysinc -mlsx|-mlasx' + '-DXXH_NO_INLINE_HINTS=1 -mllvm -inline-threshold=100000'; wrapper wrap_simd.c uses the library dispatch macros with value-arg inputs in local arrays. Plain Alive2 cannot conclude: LSX/LASX builtins stay as llvm.loongarch.{lsx,lasx}.* calls and are approximated as unknown libcalls ('Couldn't prove the correctness ... Alive2 approximated the semantics'). Secondary analysis: la_model.py replaces each intrinsic by generic IR with its ISA semantics (vld=unaligned load, vxor/vadd/vmul.d lane-wise, vsrli/vslli shifts, vmulwev.d.wu = zext(even 32-bit lanes) products, vreplgr2vr = splat, vshuf4i.w = per-128-bit-lane word shuffle), identically on both sides; *_O2 dirs additionally re-normalize both sides with opt default<O2> (no vectorizers) and strip nocapture. With -mlasx the old side uses the LSX path and the new side the LASX path. Result modulo the model: LASX accumulate_512 EQUIV to old LSX accumulate; both scramble changes (the advertised perf change) UNKNOWN because the solver cannot prove (lo32(x)*P) + ((hi32(x)*P)<<32) == x*P mod 2^64 within 600 s. initsecret control EQUIV; api_len1024 not unrolled (not pursued).
